name: Somontano

known.via: English Wikipedia "Somontano" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: An Aragon appellation on the Pyrenean foothills, whose name means "beneath the mountain". Rules allow many grapes, including Tempranillo, Garnacha Tinta, Moristel and Cabernet Sauvignon for red, and Chardonnay and Gewürztraminer for white. Wine production centers on the town of Barbastro.
